title: Incorrect handling of unauthenticated downlink RRC Setup messages can cause the baseband to crash (CVE-2025-66366)
description: A vulnerability identified as CVE-2025-66366 involves incorrect handling of unauthenticated downlink RRC Setup messages, which can cause the baseband to crash. This flaw affects the stability of the baseband component when processing certain network messages. No specific affected software versions or patches are currently documented.
